name: Resend
description: Transactional email: send messages and batches from your own verified domain.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.hint: A key with Sending access (optionally limited to one domain); it starts with re_.

hint: An API key from Resend's API Keys page, sent as a bearer token; Sending access is enough to send mail. The app sends its own User-Agent header, since Resend refuses calls without one.

smoke.note: Needs a full-access key (a sending-only key answers 401 restricted_api_key); account-wide, so run it from a terminal.

rate.note: Per team, shared by all its API keys.

example: send a welcome email to a new signup
